results.result: For positive CM trace 20 at p=179, 2 and 5 are distinct roots modulo 13 and their projective ratio 3 has exact order 3.
results.hypotheses: Explicit integer modulus 13 and the displayed characteristic polynomial; negative trace changes both eigenvalue signs and preserves their ratio.

results.result: For positive CM trace 4 at p=83, 7 and 10 are distinct roots modulo 13 and their projective ratio 7 has exact order 12.

results.result: These projective orders induce the saved degree-13 neighbor-x fiber patterns and the p=179 group-law relation ranks.
